label: ASUS Prime RTX 5070 Ti
notes:
RTX 5070 Ti machine benchmark: 13 model entries, 312 accounted cases.
LM Studio: 10 models, 240 cases (222 successful, 6 failed, 12 skipped).
Strata: 3 model variants, 72 successful cases.
Prompt targets: 512, 5000, 10000, 20000, 40000, 80000 tokens; 1 and 2 simultaneous clients; 2 planned repeats per case; output limit 256 tokens.
Engine-specific configurations, quantization format/method, transfer profiles and original runtime observations are preserved in execution sessions and source metadata.
LM Studio used per-test context and MTP off. Strata used 98304-token context and MTP on; two clients queue through one backend slot. The Qwen3.6 native engine ignores the requested conversation-cache and VRAM-reserve flags; its KV format is unreported.

collection.policy: Read-only allow-listed OS/driver probes without elevation; no unique device IDs, host names, network addresses or user paths.

memory.note: Channel topology includes source, method and capture time. Populated channels and active controller mode are distinct. Clocks are firmware/OS reports; transfer probes are stored separately.

channel_topology.note: Populated channels inferred from explicit firmware channel/slot labels, not DIMM count. Active controller mode is unverified.

pcie.note: Snapshot may show an idle downshift. Reported maxima can reflect platform limits. Encoding ceiling excludes packet/system overhead and is not measured transfer bandwidth.

capabilities.note: No FLOPS/TOPS or device-memory bandwidth measurement was performed. Model quantization bit width is not hardware arithmetic precision; peak compute also depends on operation, clock and sparsity.

storage_to_ram.note: Sequential reads of a flushed temporary file on the selected volume (results volume by default). File creation is excluded. Device/controller caches may contribute; model files on other volumes need separate measurement.

ram_to_vram.note: Pinned RAM to device memory; host wall time includes completed copies and synchronization. Separate microbenchmark, not observed inference traffic or VRAM internal bandwidth.

ram_copy_single.note: Native RAM copy payload throughput. Each payload byte requires a source read and destination write; 2x this rate is logical read+write bandwidth, not measured DRAM bus traffic. Cache/write-allocation effects and worker count influence results.

ram_copy_parallel.note: Native RAM copy payload throughput. Each payload byte requires a source read and destination write; 2x this rate is logical read+write bandwidth, not measured DRAM bus traffic. Cache/write-allocation effects and worker count influence results.

storage_volumes.note: Sequential reads of a flushed temporary file on the selected volume (results volume by default). File creation is excluded. Device/controller caches may contribute; model files on other volumes need separate measurement.

hardware_match.note: Usable physical RAM differs by at most 64 KiB; installed RAM and the listed inventory fields match. Historical inference conditions remain unverified.

measurement_scope.power_boundary: selected GPU only; not the sum of all connected GPUs

collection.policy: Read-only allow-listed OS/driver probes without elevation; no unique device IDs, host names, network addresses or user paths.

memory.note: Module count does not establish active memory channels. Clocks are firmware/OS reports; bandwidth has not been benchmarked.

pcie.note: Snapshot may show an idle downshift. Reported maxima can reflect platform limits. Encoding ceiling excludes packet/system overhead and is not measured transfer bandwidth.

capabilities.note: No FLOPS/TOPS or device-memory bandwidth measurement was performed. Model quantization bit width is not hardware arithmetic precision; peak compute also depends on operation, clock and sparsity.

storage_to_ram.note: Sequential reads of a flushed temporary file on the selected volume (results volume by default). File creation is excluded. Device/controller caches may contribute; model files on other volumes need separate measurement.

ram_to_vram.note: Pinned RAM to device memory; host wall time includes completed copies and synchronization. Separate microbenchmark, not observed inference traffic or VRAM internal bandwidth.

measurement_scope.power_boundary: selected GPU only; not the sum of all connected GPUs

idle.baseline_kind: externally managed model remains loaded; no verified idle baseline

history.note: Whole-client CPU/RAM and selected GPU; not inference-process isolation. GPU values hold the last driver snapshot only while fresh. CPU temperature is absent without a supported actual sensor. Means/peaks in summary preserve all observations despite ring eviction.

summary.drift_note: Early/late windows can overlap on runs shorter than 120 seconds. Differences describe observed workloads/environment; they do not establish thermal throttling, sustained model speed or hardware capability.
summary.coverage_note: Time-weighted coverage excludes gaps longer than four sampling intervals or one second, whichever is larger. Peaks are maxima of observed samples, not guaranteed physical peaks. Ring eviction does not change all-run aggregates.

storage_comparison.cache_policy: Fresh paired conditions on RTX 5070 Ti; identical 40 GiB host expert-cache budget for both Flash variants on both drives. Same model packages, 98304-token context, MTP requested on, reasoning none, 256 output limit, one backend slot and two queued clients. Initial SATA UD used a 600-second limit; its censored paired80K attempt is preserved and both repeats were completed with a 900-second allowance. Subsequent conditions use900 seconds. Original session-specific limits and retry evidence are retained. OS standby caches were not forcibly flushed. Historical automatic-residency inference rows remain separate and are not used as this experiment baseline. Two repeats are descriptive; actual input/output token counts are retained. Qwen3.6 MTP was requested and its block loaded, but completed-request logs must be consulted for actual drafting. Its inherited presence penalty can disable the native speculative path; this series preserves the original sampling condition.

qwen36_speculative_decoding_review.upstream_source_scope: Local upstream checkout has no changes in the three reviewed source paths; native binary equivalence was not independently established. Installed server.py hash identifies the actual Python server source.

installed_sampling_defaults.precedence: model card, configuration sampling, shared Chat settings, explicit request

resolved_presence_penalty.source: inferred from installed default merge and absent current config/shared/request overrides; not measured engine sampler telemetry

causal_chain.finding: temperature0 is not forwarded because engine default is greedy; nonzero presence penalty is forwarded as penalty_present=1.5 with penalty_last_n=64.
needs_logits() is true if temperature>0 OR repeat!=1 OR freq!=0 OR present!=0.
Speculative steps require mtp_d>0 AND !needs_logits() AND !adm, no other active slots, and sufficient context. Nonzero presence penalty therefore disables MTP attempts.
Admission BGEN returns before the final strata serve: session log. Existing final session0 lines therefore correspond to the solo request path, not proof of batching/admission.

qwen36_speculative_decoding_review.correction_policy: Preserve current matched C/F series and original312 rows. Annotate requested/loaded MTP separately from actual observed drafts. Future penalty-neutral MTP runs constitute a separate sampling condition and must retain their own configuration identity/provenance.

future_probe_without_backend_changes.why_minimal: Frequency penalty is absent/default0 and repeat penalty absent/default1 in the current setup; top_p/top_k do not make needs_logits true at temperature0.
future_probe_without_backend_changes.gateway_constraint: repetition_penalty is not a standard field accepted by the current gateway; use config sampling for that optional explicit neutralization. Standard presence_penalty0 and frequency_penalty0 are accepted and forwarded.
future_probe_without_backend_changes.verification_required: Observe offered draft count>0 on the actual request and retain counts/settings; neither accepted launch option nor speculative warmup suffices.
future_probe_without_backend_changes.batch_mtp: Not needed for one backend slot, and does not override the greedy/no-penalty gate.

expert_profile_observation.scope: After-experiment observation of the shared static Flash expert profile; not a before/after content attestation.

gpu_cache_placement_control.adjustment: NVMe budget fixed at1627 largest-expert slots to match baseline effective cache

native_expert_placement_control.correction: Strata Control rejected an unverified --expert-slots option before launch. Removed it; using supported --expert-vram 2.60 GiB to match20 GPU experts per layer. SATA requested3.0 GiB. Actual placement must match before benchmark.

model_files_copy.verification: SHA256 source stream and complete destination readback; originals retained

current_marker_and_size_check.scope: Current file sizes and stored completion markers only; payloads were not rehashed during the5070 measurement. Full78-file SHA256 verification belongs to the earlier copy operation.

memory_controller_report_request.note: Fresh controller report was not produced. Firmware populated channels and historical CPU-Z evidence remain distinct.

gpu_board_identity.scope: Commercial board identification supplied after the measurements; original session hardware snapshots preserved
